text:
maya: FYI: final plan for Jira -> GitHub Issues migration posted: https://redwood-internal/devex/jira-to-gh. Short summary here and ops notes below.

maya: Timeline: dry-run export Mon 2026-05-05 10:00 UTC, read-only freeze Mon 2026-05-12 00:00 UTC, cutover Fri 2026-05-15 02:00-06:00 UTC (writes blocked during that window).

noah: Any risk to CI that auto-links JIRA keys in commit messages?

maya: We built an actions/utils helper that rewrites issue-key mentions to GH URLs during CI. Teams should replace JIRA_API_TOKEN usage with GITHUB_TOKEN calls. Migration doc includes a sample workflow and PR template.

rita: How will attachments and issue history be preserved?

maya: Attachments copied to S3 and referenced in migrated issue bodies. Full changelog history is preserved as comments with original author and timestamp notes. Well include a mapping CSV (jira_key -> gh_issue_url).

deploy-bot: issue-migrate v1.3 dry-run kicked off by @maya at 1842510200 - scanned 2,400 issues, 8 warnings (custom fields).

tom: Who should own automations that don't translate?

maya: DevEx + Eng-Infra will migrate high-priority automations (severity labels, sprint->milestone). Low-priority/custom rules will be listed for manual rebuild; owners will be notified to re-create with GH Actions.

security-bot: SCIM provisioning unchanged; team mapping requires a final review.

jules: Ops runbooks that reference Jira will break during freeze. Can we flag runbooks needing exceptions?

maya: Yes. Add exceptions to the "freeze-exceptions" section in the migration doc by EOD Thu. Emergency edits allowed via #eng-oncall with tracked approval.

noah: I can QA product-ui after dry-run.

rita: Ill audit infra projects.

maya: Thanks! Volunteers noted. Next steps: read the doc, sign up for spot-checks, join dry-run sync Tue 10:00 UTC. Well post dry-run logs here. :calendar: :rocket:
